```bash
python3 /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/spawn-task.py complete t125 "结果摘要（一句话）"
```

失败时:
```bash
python3 /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/spawn-task.py fail t125 "失败原因"
```
